title: Expanding fare-free bus passes
summary: Bill 95 (2026), which expands fare-free bus pass eligibility and aims to raise Maui bus ridership, passed first reading 8–0 on July 24, and an August 11 item describes it as expanding the fare-free pass program. At a July 2 committee meeting, the director said new fiscal 2027 bus fares took effect July 1 and the bill would write them into County code. He estimated each free day would cost about $2,806 in uncollected fares, and free regular routes would also make paratransit free under federal rules.
